native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Lsass Process Dump
native_rule.s1ql:
"(EndpointOS == ""Windows"" and EventType == ""Process Creation"") and
(
  (
    CmdLine contains_anycase [""-ma lsass.exe"", "" (ps lsass).id ""] or
    CmdLine regexp `comsvcs\.dll,\s{0,5}MiniDump ` or
    CmdLine regexp `(?i)(lsass(\.exe\.){0,1}[0-9]{0,3}\.dmp$)` or
    TgtFilePath contains_anycase `:\Windows\Temp\dumpert.dmp` or
    SrcProcCmdline contains_ic ""live lsa""
  )
  and SrcProcName not_in [""WerFault.exe"", ""wermgr.exe"", ""mvserver.exe""]
  and not (TgtProcCmdLine contains_anycase `\systemprofile\AppData\Local\CrashDumps`)
)"
